sources.excerpt: Judge Death Deathbringer Warthog by ThorpyFX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE ThorpyFX Judge Death Deathbringer Warthog LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description From the ashes of Deadworld comes the Judge Death Deathbringer, a pedal of pure sonic annihilation. Built around the revered Warthog circuit, it moves seamlessly from crystal-clear boost to fuzzed-out chaos. Each setting reveals a three-dimensional tone that leaps from the fretboard with brutal clarity. Its voice sits firmly in the American camp, from sparkling cleans to crushing, fuzz-edged distortion. Constructed like a weapon, it features recessed controls, top-mounted jacks, and a laser-engraved aluminum console. Inside, premium components and engineering deliver tone and toughness in equal measure.
